exam.study_prerequisites: Microsoft 365 or Power Platform familiarity, solution-architecture fundamentals, and access to suitable Copilot or agent environments for complete labs.

guide_sections: Part 1 — Complexity ladder and bounded control loop
Part 3 — Prompt library and small-language-model decisions
Part 4 — Agentic unit-cost model and execution budgets
Parts 6–7 — Generative pages, agent feed, and Dynamics 365 orchestration
Parts 8 and 10 — Trajectory evaluation, release gates, threat modeling, and human intervention

review.notes: All three weighted objective groups and their July 22, 2026 bullets are mapped to business-process and architecture decisions, operational/governance playbooks, 11 architecture exercises, and 17 checks. The September 6 learning expansion adds an evidence hierarchy for supplementary sources, an agentic complexity ladder, a bounded control loop, unit-cost analysis, orchestration-pattern selection, trajectory evaluation, release gates, agentic abuse cases, and binding human intervention. Practitioner material from Microsoft architecture guidance, Anthropic, OpenAI, AWS, Google, NIST, OWASP, and Microsoft WorkLab is explicitly separated from exam and Microsoft product authority. All 51 cited URLs are cataloged: 46 reachable and five access-blocked; none are missing or errored. The September 7 watch adds roadmap, harness, Agent 365, and Copilot-release boundaries; no exam dumps or recalled items were used. September 17, 2026 lifecycle check: added the announced October revision and current date evidence to the guide and catalog. This is a bounded notice update; historical objective snapshot and full-review date remain unchanged. See docs/research/2026-09-17-exam-validation.md. September 27, 2026: registered and checked citations for the bounded update; link counts reconciled. This does not renew the historical full-guide or blueprint review.

findings.resolution: Added explicit privacy limits and separated assistance, data entry and informational review.
